page_title: MNU 0-1 WOL | Manchester Utd v Wolves 20/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is penalised for a foul. Robert Jones had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+7' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+4' We are about to witness a substitution. Nasser Djiga (Wolves) is replacing Matheus Cunha.
90+3' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester Utd.
90+1' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Manchester Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

89' Manchester Utd are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a throw-in.

86' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Mason Mount, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.

84' Mason Mount (Manchester United) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
82' Vitor Pereira has decided to substitute Rayan Ait Nouri and he is replaced by Matt Doherty (Wolves).

82' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the top left corner, but Andre Onana made a crucial save!
80' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) picked up a yellow card from referee.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Leny Yoro (Manchester United) for Victor Lindelof.
77' 0 - 1 Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) shoots from the free kick just outside the box, hitting the top right corner. Football supporters are always pleased to see such a fabulous goal.
77' Wolves have a free kick.
76' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) picks up a yellow card.
74' Substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen did his best and is replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
74' Vitor Pereira decides to make a substitution. Nelson Semedo will be replaced by Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).

74' Alejandro Garnacho plays a pass to Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
73' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
72' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Daniel Bentley.
70' Substitution. Chidozie Obi (Manchester United) on for Rasmus Hojlund.
69' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
67' Robert Jones blows his whistle and it's Mason Mount (Manchester United) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
66' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
64' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) sends another sweet pass into the area between the defenders where Alejandro Garnacho is normally lurking.
62' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
61' Mason Mount (Manchester United) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robert Jones blows for a foul.
61' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) sprays a pass out to Nelson Semedo, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
59' The game has come to an end for Manuel Ugarte. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).
59' Here is a change. Patrick Dorgu is going off and Ruben Amorim gives the last tactical orders to Diogo Dalot (Manchester United).
59' Substitution. Mason Mount (Manchester United) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Kobbie Mainoo walks off.
58' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
58' The corner from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is cleared away by the defence.
56' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' The ball is cleared after Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) sends a chip pass into the box, but Andre Onana is quickest to intercept the ball.
49' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
48' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
47' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes a short corner kick.
47' Manchester Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester Utd can continue in their attacking effort.
47' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' Robert Jones blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Alejandro Garnacho links up with Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United), who fires just wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
43' Robert Jones blows his whistle as Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
43' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
42' Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul after Toti (Wolves) hacks down one of his opponents. Manchester Utd are awarded a free kick.

39' Marshall Munetsi nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
37' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
37' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) sends the corner into the box, but Daniel Bentley intercepts it and averts the threat.

36' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety. Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' None of the Manchester Utd players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
34' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Daniel Bentley to dive and make a save.
33' Robert Jones blows for a foul after Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
31' The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
31' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
30' The corner from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is intercepted by Daniel Bentley.
29' Andre (Wolves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
28' The resulting set piece from Manchester Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

27' Rasmus Hojlund receives a sweet cross inside the box from Harry Amass (Manchester United), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball. Good work from Manchester Utd as they win a corner.
27' A spell of possession for Manchester Utd in an attempt to control the game.

23' Andre lays the ball off to Nelson Semedo (Wolves), who hurriedly shoots from long range and sends the ball high over the bar into row Z. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
21' Joao Gomes (Wolves) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
19' A player from Wolves commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
17' An attempted cross from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is cleared. It's a throw-in for Wolves.

14' Alejandro Garnacho almost found himself in a promising position after Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
12' Wonderful pass from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) for Kobbie Mainoo, but they can't profit from it as Daniel Bentley comes off his line to collect.
11' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is caught offside!
10' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.
10' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for an infringement. Wolves have a free kick from a promising distance.
6' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.

6' Harry Amass (Manchester United) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The linesman signals a throw-in for Manchester Utd.
5' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
4' Manchester Utd are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
3' Joao Gomes (Wolves) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
2' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

The players are on the pitch and Wolves will have the kick-off.
